title: Puffco Plus 3.0 WAX Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
The Puffco Plus 3.0 Portable Concentrate Vaporizer adds refined and effective accents to the practical Puffco Plus vape. The Puffco Plus 3.0 bridges innovation and convenience with its combined card cap, loading tool, and splash guard, all built into the mouthpiece. The tip of the mouthpiece presses down to extend the loading tool to make preparation simple and clean.

This advanced oil vaporizer features 3 heat settings so you can get thick smoke clouds and sneak tiny puffs. The Puffco Plus 3.0 also wields “Sesh-mode” functionality, maintaining continuous heat for 12 full seconds so you can achieve a full medical dose.

The vape has an integrated silicone exterior around the ceramic chamber to prevent transfer of heat, making this pocket-sized vaporizer great for sneaking puffs on the go. Enjoy the Puffco Plus 3.0 Vaporizer in discreet Onyx black or luscious Pearl white.

Features:
520mAh battery capacity
Puffco Plus 3.0 concentrate vape
Coil-less ceramic bowl
3 heat settings
Sesh mode functionality
Built-in extendable loading dart / carb cap
Fast-charging & long-lasting battery
Replaceable ceramic chamber

Kit Includes:
Plus 3.0 510 battery
Plus 3.0 mouthpiece w/ dart
Plus 3.0 chamber & grip
Plus Supercharger charge cord
Cotton swabs

Warranty
For any device or troubleshooting issues, please email support@puffco.com
For warranty Service follow this link.
